The bug is confirmed: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 29 at the right edge of the 33-byte target buffer, exactly at `memsearch_swar` line 52 (`memcmp(p+1, xs+1, m-1)`). Now I need to construct a Ruby program that reaches this via `str[other_str]`.

The key challenge: the target string must be heap-allocated (len > 27 for 64-bit embed threshold) and the pattern must be length >= 2. Let me verify the embed threshold and how strings are created in mruby.
